3. **Banking-Grade Encrypted WebRTC Video eKYC (PVcomBank):** Engineered a standalone real-time video call and customer verification module using custom WebRTC signaling, DTLS-SRTP media encryption, load-balanced WebSockets, and zero-trust token authentication.
